name: map-style-round3
question: Two questions at once. DISTINCTNESS (Hank's second critique — two of three shipped drafts looked the same): run the round-1 winning town recipe on three different biomes and see whether Brackwater, Cindershelf and Bowerdeep come out as three different places. SCALE (round 2's route failure): routes came out as a dead-straight causeway at close-up scale, so v5/v6 add 'winding' and an explicit far-above framing. Round 2 also established two anti-patterns now avoided: naming what the OTHER edges are ('unbroken hedgerow every other edge') produces a rectangular boundary and a path grid, and 'the ONLY road leaving the picture' does not reduce the number of roads that leave it.
